findings.title: Mark as… offers Refund of… on a money-out payment, and spending then falls by twice the payment
findings.detail: `txn` > *Mark as…* lists Transfer and *Refund of…* for an outgoing payment (Income is correctly in-only). Choosing a purchase to refund turns the RM10.00 payment itself into `kind: refund`, which stops counting as spending, and the purchase it points at is reduced by the same RM10.00. Home's spent figure falls by RM20.00 and *Left until payday* rises by RM20.00 for one RM10.00 payment. A refund is money in (spec §7, D21: *Money in … a refund of a purchase*), so the option should not exist on a money-out row. Undo restores it.
findings.repro: pnpm dev; open /s/payments, search KEDAI MAKAN AH CHOY, open it, Mark as… > Refund of… > first ZUS COFFEE row. Then Home. (qa/e2e/b03-r3.spec.ts, R3-B)
findings.spec: R3-6, spec_v2.md §7 (Refunds, D21), screens.md `txn` Mark as…

findings.title: By hand, Enter in the Add item price adds the item and then shows two errors
findings.detail: The price field calls `submit()` on Enter and the form also submits on Enter, so it runs twice. The first run adds the item and clears both fields; the second finds them empty and shows *Say what it is.* and *Type the amount.* on a form that just worked. On the phone, the keyboard's Done key is that Enter. Manual's Enter saves once (it is guarded by the disabled button); Add item has no such guard.

findings.title: A scanned receipt whose check fails can still be done, and commits the items' sum as its total
findings.detail: Fixing the doubtful *Nasi impit* from RM4.50 to RM9.50 moves the check to *Items come to RM5.00 more than the receipt's total*, but *Done* stays enabled. The receipt is committed with total RM69.13, not the printed RM64.13, so it no longer matches the RM64.13 payment and goes to *Waiting for its payment* instead of attaching. §6.4: a failed check marks the total doubtful; matching and the total are the receipt's printed ones.

findings.title: The D19 repayment clause of `spendingOf` is not pinned by `pnpm test`
findings.detail: Probe: change `Math.min(share, t.amount - repaid)` to `Math.min(share, t.amount)` in `data/fake/views.ts`. `fake.test.ts` stays 30/30 green: the one D19 test (`counts a split bill as your share`) uses a bill whose repayments never exceed the unowed part. Only QA's own `b03-money.spec.ts` goes red, and it is not in CI. The refund clause beside it is pinned (probe caught).

findings.title: Read from the code, not run: the fake's Undo restores a whole snapshot of the database
findings.detail: `run({type:'undo'})` sets `db = before`, so undoing change A after change B also drops B. The UI only offers the latest toast's Undo, so no tap reaches it; B05's route needs its own per-command inverse.
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/data/fake/index.ts: `db = before`

findings.title: Process: a `pkill -f vite` from this run stopped the parent session's `pnpm e2e` preview servers
findings.detail: While `pnpm e2e` was running on :4173/:4174, the reviewer killed every `vite` process to free ports, which took those two servers down for a few minutes (the reviewer restarted them). Failures in that run's window are not product failures: re-run `pnpm e2e` in the parent session. The reviewer then used :5180-:5183 and killed only its own PIDs.
